import sys

def main():
    input_data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    w = int(input_data[0])
    m = int(input_data[1])
    res = True
    while m > 0:
        if m % w == 0 or m % w - 1 == 0:
            m //= w
        elif m % w + 1 == w:
            m += 1
        else:
            res = False
            break
    print("YES" if res else "NO")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
